stories.title: Le Prix Nobel de physique est décerné au Belge Francis Halzen pour la détection d’un neutrino de très haute énergie

en.title: The Nobel Prize in Physics is awarded to Belgian Francis Halzen for the detection of a very high-energy neutrino
en.summary: Belgian researcher Francis Halzen won the Nobel Prize in Physics for his work on detecting neutrinos from space. Sweden's Royal Academy of Sciences recognized his contributions to understanding these ghost-like particles.

stories.title: La pop à bout portant de Leila, la Bernoise aux millions de streams

en.title: The point-blank pop of Leila, the Swiss artist with millions of streams
en.summary: Bernese singer Leila released her debut album five years after the viral success of Gun to My Head, which accumulated over 5 million streams. Her independent pop sound was composed across Switzerland, Sarajevo, and New York.

stories.title: Der belgisch-amerikanische Neutrinoforscher Francis Halzen erhält den Physiknobelpreis

en.title: Belgian-American neutrino researcher Francis Halzen receives the Physics Nobel Prize
en.summary: Francis Halzen received the Nobel Prize in Physics for his crucial contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin.

stories.title: Francis Halzen reçoit le prix Nobel de physique pour ses recherches sur les neutrinos

en.title: Francis Halzen receives the Nobel Prize in Physics for his research on neutrinos
en.summary: Francis Halzen received the Nobel Prize in Physics for his research on neutrinos, described as ghostly messengers from space. He made decisive contributions to the design of the IceCube Neutrino Observatory.
